description.value: The study examined whether CHRNA5 rs16969968 genotype is associated with brain fMRI reactivity to smoking versus neutral images in nicotine-dependent women.

spans.text: To determine whether rs16969968 moderates fMRI-measured brain reactivity to smoking cues, we compared two groups of women whose nicotine dependence severity was equivalent, with one group expressing an A allele and the other expressing 2 copies of the G allele.
